    Top Of The Pops 20/10/1983_Andy Peebles and Janice Long take a look at Britain's best-selling tracks and artists from the Top 40. Including performances from:

    David Grant Love Will Find A Way.
    The Rocksteady Crew (Hey You) The Rocksteady Crew.
    Howard Jones New Song.
    Billy Joel Uptown Girl.
    Gary Numan Sister Surprise.
    Freeez Pop Goes My Love.
    Elton John Kiss The Bride.
    Depeche Mode Love In Itself 2.
    Men Without Hats The Safety Dance.
    Culture Club Karma Chameleon.
    Meat Loaf Midnight At The Lost & Found.

    Last on BBC Four Sat 19 Oct 2024.

    ​
    The ARIRANG WORLD TOUR is the fourth concert tour by the South Korean boy band BTS, in support of their 2026 studio album, ARIRANG. The tour began on April 9, 2026, in Goyang and continue through 2027. Marking BTS's return to live performances after completing their mandatory military service, it spans more than 85 dates in 34 cities across 23 countries.
